section_patterns.name: permission_matrix
section_patterns.purpose: Prevents unauthorized actions and clarifies who can see, edit, or manage entities.

section_patterns.name: accessibility_support
section_patterns.purpose: Ensures equitable user experience across physical, sensory, and cognitive limitations.

section_patterns.name: ai_detection
section_patterns.purpose: Defines requirements and constraints for AI-based field and recipient detection, preventing misuse or misinterpretation.

section_patterns.name: api_documentation_and_support
section_patterns.purpose: Prevents developer confusion and friction by setting standards for API clarity and assistance.

section_patterns.name: attribute_reference
section_patterns.purpose: Clarifies record schema and relation, reducing errors in attribute use across tickets and articles.

section_patterns.name: bounce_handling
section_patterns.purpose: Defines bounce processing and classification to settle error recovery and notification procedures.

section_patterns.name: bulk_operations
section_patterns.purpose: Details procedures for batch-changing records, making clear how mass updates, confirmations, and associated notes are handled.

section_patterns.name: custom_data_model
section_patterns.purpose: Ensures the product can model any business's data structure flexibly.

precision_idioms.name: explicit_default
precision_idioms.example: The default is Everyone. Change it in document preferences.

precision_idioms.name: state_transition_rule
precision_idioms.template: From A to B only when C.
precision_idioms.example: Recipients receive the document one at a time, in the order you specify. Each person must complete their action before the next person is notified.

precision_idioms.name: permission_matrix
precision_idioms.template: Role X may do Y; Role Z must not do Y.

precision_idioms.name: must_never_invariant
precision_idioms.template: X must never Y; verified by Z.
precision_idioms.example: Each signer must have at least one Signature field assigned to them. The document cannot be sent without this.

precision_idioms.name: bounded_window
precision_idioms.template: X is allowed within N units (e.g., days, requests).
precision_idioms.example: Helpful rate limits are in place (up to 3 detection requests per minute per IP) to prevent abuse.

precision_idioms.name: attribute_table
precision_idioms.template: A structured list: attribute name, type, and notes (for explicit schema documentation).
precision_idioms.example:
number: string
title: string
group: object (group.name, ...)...

precision_idioms.name: contextual_availability
precision_idioms.template: X is only available or visible when Y is true.
precision_idioms.example: Text modules can be tied to groups: if that's the case, they are only available once the ticket you're working on has been assigned to …

precision_idioms.name: edge_case_fallback
precision_idioms.template: If X is not available, Y is used.
precision_idioms.example: If a language has no matching bundle, your translated survey content is still shown as usual, but these built-in interface strings fall back to English.

edge_case_patterns.name: access_restriction_on_notification
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Subscriptions and notifications for a record are only effective if user already has permission to access the record.

edge_case_patterns.name: attribute_fallback
edge_case_patterns.resolution: If an attribute-based operation (e.g., search by file type) fails, provide required alternate data (e.g., MIME type) to resolve.

edge_case_patterns.name: bounce_classification
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Bounces are classified by heuristics; if no match, a default category applies.

edge_case_patterns.name: cognitive_impairment
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Support features are offered to help navigation and comprehension for users with cognitive limitations.

edge_case_patterns.name: default_inheritance
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Team-level settings override organisation-level defaults explicitly.

edge_case_patterns.name: device_setup_by_non_technical_users
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Devices are pre-installed or easy to deploy, so setup is not required by users with low technical ability.

edge_case_patterns.name: duplicate_detection
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Existing recipients and duplicates are preserved and not re-added.

edge_case_patterns.name: duplicate_notification
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Multiple notifications for the same object are summarized and prioritized according to configured precedence rules.
